description: Start an API draft for a website that no catalog API covers. maviapi's build agent studies the site and builds a JSON API from a plain-language description. This returns a request_id at once; follow it with get_build_status. Build completion does not publish the API. Use your own account and key to review and publish the draft in the dashboard. With the shared demo key each network gets 3 free builds per 30 days.

build_anyway.description: Build even though the catalog already has an API for this site (it lacks what you need).

description.description: The data wanted from the site, as specific as you can: pages, fields, filters. E.g. "front-page stories with title, url, points, comment count and author".

name: create_api
title: Build a new maviapi API
